sources.title: Free AI Detector - AI Detection in Seconds
sources.snippet: Grammarly's free AI checker is trained to detect AI-generated content and help you fix it. Detect AI-generated content from Grammarly, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and others in a click.

sources.title: GitHub - abhinav7289A/Hinglish-turn-detection
sources.snippet: A tiny (<10M param), fast (<50 ms CPU), audio-only turn-detection model for Indian Hinglish, Indian-accented English, and Indian filler words — plus the first human-labelled Hinglish turn-detection benchmark to evaluate it on.

sources.title: abhishek-040010/smart-turn-hinglish · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Smart Turn Hinglish: Conversational Turn-Taking & Hesitation Detection for Code-Switched Speech Smart Turn Hinglish is an acoustic conversational turn-detection model designed for real-time voice AI agents in Hindi-English (Hinglish) conversational environments.

sources.title: GitHub - ZoroZoro95/hinglish-turn-detector
sources.snippet: An audio-only research prototype that decides whether a voice agent should respond or keep listening. It was built for the Shiprocket turn-detection challenge with particular attention to Hinglish, fillers, thinking pauses, incomplete sentences, evaluation leakage, and CPU latency.
